about: 意味の規則の較正の見張り — jev-lint の labels.json の札で、際どくない正例と反例(agora-controllers 379ebcdd の定義の写し)。正例は p >= 0.8、反例は p <= 0.2 に入るはず(試作の 4 回の実測: 正例 0.91〜0.97・反例 0.03〜0.06)。 DOEFF204 の 2 例は合成(operator の例 — client を欄に持つ窓口と、Point2D の値の class)。比べるのは external-world の確率。 DOEFF205 の 2 例は agora-controllers 068dee21 の写し(正例 = 形の検めと判断が混ざった decide-tag・反例 = 型のある盤の上の純粋な判断 card-tags-of)。比べるのは mixed の確率。

items.name: may-manage?
items.source:
(defk may-manage? [by]
  {:pre [(: by str)] :post [(: % (| bool Unavailable))] :tags {:context "chat" :role "protocol"}}
  "by が参加者を出し入れしてよいか — chat を開ける者と同じ(machine を名乗れる principal か方策の openers)。方策に届かなければ Unavailable。"
  (<- as-machine bool (may-act-as by "machine"))
  (when as-machine
    (return True))
  (<- policy (| DeliveryPolicy None Unavailable) (read-policy))
  (match policy
    (Unavailable) policy
    None False
    _ (in by policy.openers)))

items.name: post-json
items.source:
(defk post-json [url headers body]
  {:pre [(: url str) (: headers dict) (: body bytes)] :post [(: % dict)]
   :tags {:context "classifier" :role "protocol"}}
  "1 回の呼び(撃ち直し込み)の答えの JSON を dict で返す — jev-evaluation の節が問いごとに読む元。計器は効果 CountMetric で数える
   (呼び・撃ち直し・不達の 3 本)。撃ち直しは網と engine の断りにだけ効かせ、答えの読みは輪の外(形の違いを撃ち直しても直らない)。"
  (var attempt 0)
  (var text None)
  (while (is text None)
    (:= attempt (+ attempt 1))
    (<- outcome (post-once url headers body))
    (val retry (<= attempt MAX-RETRIES))
    (match outcome
      (PostAnswered :text answered)
      (do (<- (CountMetric METRIC-JEV-CALLS))
          (:= text answered))
      (PostRefused :status status :detail detail)
      (if (and (in status RETRY-STATUSES) retry)
          (<- (wait-before-retry attempt))
          (<- (give-up (+ "Jev HTTP " (str status) ": " detail))))
      (PostUnreached :detail detail)
      (if retry
          (<- (wait-before-retry attempt))
          (<- (give-up (+ "Jev へ届かない: " detail))))))
  (var payload None)
  (try
    (:= payload (json.loads text))
    (except [e ValueError]
      (raise (JevAnswerShape (+ "Jev の答えが JSON でない: " (str e))))))
  (when (not (isinstance payload dict))
    (raise (JevAnswerShape "Jev の答えが object でない")))
  payload)

items.name: classifier-call
items.source:
(defk classifier-call [ports method route body timeout]
  {:pre [(: ports PeerPorts) (: method str) (: route str) (: body (| dict None)) (: timeout float)]
   :post [(: % ClassifierOutcome)]}
  ;; 係を 1 回読んだ結末(閉じた和 — 口が無い = Unasked〔撃たない〕・期限切れ = TimedOut・届かない = Unreachable〔理由は誤りの逐語〕・
  ;; 答え = Answered)。method は呼び手の読みの 3 点が名指す(POST は /evaluate と /view/evaluate の 2 つ — 本文が要る読み)。
  ;; ⚠ 鍵も Jev の URL も持たない(R10 鍵は係だけ — 知るのは係の宛先 1 つ)。
  (val base ports.classifier-url)
  (when (is base None)
    (return (ClassifierUnasked)))
  (try
    (<- response HttpResponse (HttpRequest method (+ (.rstrip base "/") route)
                                           :headers (if (is body None) ACCEPT-JSON (| ACCEPT-JSON {"Content-Type" "application/json"}))
                                           :body (if (is body None) None (json.dumps body :ensure-ascii False))
                                           :timeout-seconds timeout :max-retries 0 :follow-redirects False))
    (except [error TimeoutError]
      (return (ClassifierTimedOut (str error))))
    (except [error OSError]
      (return (ClassifierUnreachable (str error)))))
  (ClassifierAnswered response.status response.text))

items.name: wake
items.source:
(defk wake [message members policy]
  {:pre [(: message Message) (: members tuple) (: policy WakePolicy)] :post [(: % tuple)] :tags {:context "chat" :role "judgment"}}
  "投稿 1 通で起こす参加者の列(問い A の 1 点)。members = members-of の答え(今参加している参加者だけ — 参加していない agent は
   名指されても起こさない)。差出人自身は起こさない(agent が自分の投稿で自分を起こさない)・画面は起こさない(記録を読む)。
     named-or-primary: 投稿が名指した(mentions)参加者が居ればそれだけ、居なければ主担当 1 つ(pane の chat は pane 1 つ)
     all-others:       差出人以外の agent と pane の全員"
  (val candidates (lfor p members
                         :if (and (isinstance p #(AgentParticipant PaneParticipant)) (!= p.agent message.sender))
                         p))
  (match policy
    WakePolicy.NAMED-OR-PRIMARY
    (do (val named (lfor p candidates :if (in p.agent (or message.mentions #())) p))
        (cond
          named (tuple named)
          True (tuple (gfor p candidates :if (or (isinstance p PaneParticipant) p.primary) p))))
    WakePolicy.ALL-OTHERS (tuple candidates)))

items.name: RecordsClient
items.source:
(defclass [(dataclass :frozen True)] RecordsClient []
  "記録の service の行を読み書きする口。"
  (#^ httpx.AsyncClient client)
  (#^ str base-url)

  (defn/a list-rows [self #^ str table]
    (setv response (await (.get self.client f"{self.base-url}/rows/{table}")))
    (.json response))

  (defn/a put-row [self #^ str table #^ dict row]
    (await (.post self.client f"{self.base-url}/rows/{table}" :json row))))

items.name: Point2D
items.source:
(defclass [(dataclass :frozen True)] Point2D []
  "平面の点。"
  (#^ float x)
  (#^ float y)

  (defn #^ float norm [self]
    (math.sqrt (+ (* self.x self.x) (* self.y self.y))))

  (defn #^ Point2D add [self #^ Point2D other]
    (Point2D (+ self.x other.x) (+ self.y other.y))))

items.name: decide-tag
items.source:
(defk decide-tag [intent board settings]
  {:pre [(: intent BoardIntent) (: board Board) (: settings BoardWriteSettings)]
   :post [(: % WritePlan)]
   :tags {:context "kanban" :role "judgment"}}
  "kanban-tag: 付け先の札を足し外しする(頭の註の規則と断りの順)。"
  (val payload intent.payload)
  (val subject (.get payload "subject"))
  (when (not (and (isinstance subject str) (!= subject "")))
    (<- bad-subject WritePlan (rejected (+ REJECT-PAYLOAD-INVALID ": subject")))
    (return bad-subject))
  (<- by (| str None) (named-by (.get payload "by") intent.by))
  (when (is by None)
    (<- bad-by WritePlan (rejected (+ REJECT-BY-NOT-ALLOWED ": " (repr (.get payload "by")))))
    (return bad-by))
  (<- known bool (subject-on-board board subject))
  (when (not known)
    (<- unknown WritePlan (rejected (+ REJECT-SUBJECT-UNKNOWN ": " subject)))
    (return unknown))
  (<- add (| list None) (tag-list payload "add"))
  (<- remove (| list None) (tag-list payload "remove"))
  (when (or (is add None) (is remove None))
    (<- bad-lists WritePlan (rejected (+ REJECT-PAYLOAD-INVALID ": add / remove")))
    (return bad-lists))
  (when (and (not add) (not remove))
    (<- empty WritePlan (rejected (+ REJECT-PAYLOAD-INVALID ": add も remove も無い")))
    (return empty))
  (<- add-said (| TagsAccepted Refusal) (tags-verdict add by True))
  (match add-said
    (Refusal) (do (<- add-refused WritePlan (rejected (+ add-said.reason ": " add-said.detail)))
                  (return add-refused))
    (TagsAccepted) None)
  (<- remove-said (| TagsAccepted Refusal) (tags-verdict remove by False))
  (match remove-said
    (Refusal) (do (<- remove-refused WritePlan (rejected (+ remove-said.reason ": " remove-said.detail)))
                  (return remove-refused))
    (TagsAccepted) None)
  (val adding add-said.words)
  (val removing remove-said.words)
  (val both (lfor word adding :if (in word removing) word))
  (when both
    (<- overlap WritePlan (rejected (+ REJECT-PAYLOAD-INVALID ": 同じ札が add と remove の両方に在る: " (.join ", " both))))
    (return overlap))
  (<- live tuple (live-tags-of board.tags subject))
  (var writes #())
  (for [word adding]
    (when (not (any (gfor row live (= row.tag word))))
      (<- row-id str (request-row-id TAG-ID-PREFIX intent.request-id (+ subject "|" word)))
      (:= writes (+ writes #((AttachTag :namespace settings.namespace :row-id row-id :subject subject :tag word :by by))))))
  ;; 外す札は同じ綴りの生きた行を全部閉じる(旧 daemon の族の行と 1 札 1 行の形が同じ札を 2 本持つ拍もある — 旧い _live-tags と同じ)。
  (for [word removing]
    (for [row live]
      (when (= row.tag word)
        (:= writes (+ writes #((CloseTag :namespace settings.namespace :row-id row.row-id :version row.version)))))))
  (if writes
      (WritePlan :writes writes :outcome None)
      (WritePlan :writes #() :outcome (TagDone :added adding :removed removing))))

items.name: card-tags-of
items.source:
(defk card-tags-of [board key]
  {:tags {:context "kanban" :role "judgment"} :pre [(: board Board) (: key str)] :post [(: % (| CardTags CardMissing))]}
  "card 1 枚の札(頭の註)— 札の付け外しの土台と `ai tell --card` の作業場の導出が読むため。無い card を「札が 0 枚の card」と読ませない。"
  (when (not (any (gfor card board.cards (= card.key key))))
    (return (CardMissing :key key)))
  (val ordered (tuple (sorted board.tags :key (fn [tag] tag.key))))
  (<- live tuple (live-tags-of ordered key))
  (CardTags :card key
            :rows (tuple (gfor tag ordered :if (= tag.subject key)
                               (CardTag :key tag.key :tag tag.tag :removed tag.removed :by tag.by)))
            :live (tuple (gfor tag live tag.tag))))
